jobs.description: About the BIIE The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region. Position Overview We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences. Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities. This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events. Key Responsibilities Content Creation Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials. Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. Today, patients and medical staff waste countless hours on the phone, struggling through complex insurance policies and outdated scheduling systems. Leading hospitals, insurers, and digital health companies deploy Ferry's AI platform to solve this problem for their patients. We offer an SMS-based concierge service that helps patients find and book the care they need — at no cost to them.
